 DC News Now More rain possible east of I-95, drier to the west
 Damon Matson Thu, November 5, 2026 at 9:35 PM UTC 3 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. The dry streak is finally over! Scattered showers rolled through overnight into early this morning, giving most of us our first measurable rainfall since mid-October. It wasn't much, given how light and fast-moving the rain was, but it was something at least. Drier conditions are winning out this afternoon, with breezy southerly winds keeping it quite warm in the 70s. The cold front hasn't totally crossed the region yet, and another wave of rain is likely to develop east of the front this evening and into the night. Locations west of DC and I-95 are likely done with the wet weather from this event, but locations along and east of DC and I-95 likely see more scattered rain. Conditions start turning soggy again around 6-8 PM, with pockets of steadier rain possible after midnight.
 Some rain will continue to roll through to the east through tomorrow morning as the cold front gets hung up along the coast. Parts of southern MD could see a healthy amount of rain, close to an inch or more, while the rest of us barely scrape out a quarter of an inch. Once the front is finally through and it starts to dry out, chillier air will return for the weekend. Afternoon highs will still be around 70 degrees tomorrow, but we'll struggle to hit 60 degrees on Saturday and Sunday. Breezy northwest winds will make it feel a bit brisk on Saturday, with some clouds also hanging around. Overnight lows will be back in the 30s and 40s over the weekend as well, so be ready to bring the heavier jackets back out for any plans you have.
 We'll gradually see more sunshine and head into our next extended dry stretch early next week. A series of fronts will pass by Monday through Wednesday, leading to a small warm-up (highs in the upper 60s by Tuesday) followed by a solid cooldown (highs in the mid-50s by next Thursday), but those will be the only significant changes. No rain is showing up in the extended forecast, with the weather pattern turning stagnant again.
